common_evidence_points: The source is an official HSE primary guidance page under the UK public-sector hse.gov.uk domain.
The page was live-opened successfully on 1 August 2026.
The URL passed the official HSE domain allowlist.
The exact URL was absent from the repository's previous 1,115 source families.
Its scope is source-specific and should not be generalised beyond the stated workplace, water system, construction activity, hazardous substance, exposure, dutyholder or control function.
Operational use requires confirmation of the current page version, responsible persons, site and system characteristics, affected people, timing and supporting evidence.
A checklist, safety data sheet, report, measurement, inspection or risk assessment alone does not establish that every legal or safety requirement has been satisfied.

Final decisions require the current official scope plus exact hazard, exposure, engineering, operational, competence, health-surveillance, emergency, reporting, communication, governance and review evidence.
